purpose: Machine-applicable form of the theorem-level exclusions. B13-11's results/b13_11/inherited_rules.json names the rules in prose; this gives each one a predicate over (n, r, delta) so a cell catalog can be joined against it. This file is the PROVED-index-to-catalog join; keeping them apart is what let batch 13 close the same cells twice.

exclusions.statement: D_k^{per_3} = Sym^3 C^k for k <= 5, so I(D_k^{per_3})_delta = 0 at every degree.
exclusions.witness: exact full-Jacobian rank 35 at both house primes; re-derived from its generator by B13-07

exclusions.source: delta<=6 Pieri + s37 (docs/transfer_lemma.md sec 4); delta=7 s41+s43 (27 weights); delta=8 s41+s43+s47 (91); delta=9 s79 (210)
exclusions.witness: full ranks at both primes; counts independently reproduced by B13-05, B13-07, B13-09 and B13-11

exclusions.statement: I(D_r^{per_3})_delta = 0 for EVERY r and every delta <= 8; hence mult_pad = mult_red at every weight of every length in every degree <= 8.
exclusions.source: RECONCILIATION RESULT, stated by no single session. length<=5 washout_thm2; length 6 length6_record; length 7 at delta=8 B13-09 (all 42); length 8 at delta=8 B13-05 top cells (all 6). Theorem A of B13-05 bounds the length at min(r, delta, 9), so those are all of them.
exclusions.witness: tools/integrate/reconcile_cells.py frontier table: r=7 d=8 42/42, r=8 d=8 6/6
exclusions.note: B13-05 alone proves delta <= 7. The extension to 8 needs B13-09's length-7 group AND B13-05's length-8 top cells together.

exclusions.statement: Generic four-variable cubics have a 3x3 determinantal representation, so l*c = det diag(l,M) puts the reducible - hence padded - locus inside the determinant closure: no positive padded gap at quartic length <= 4.
exclusions.note: A containment exclusion, NOT an empty-determinant-ideal assertion. The board never cited this; B13-11 had to find it, and without it would have reported 19 false open candidates.

exclusions.source: B13-06 section 'Why the two ladder products cannot improve the gap'
exclusions.note: PRESERVES an unresolved D; does NOT establish D <= 0. Later rungs are not independent opportunities and must not be re-dispatched as such.

exclusions.statement: l*per_3 has ten essential variables, so its orbit closure lies in the ten-variable subspace variety and carries no constituent of length > 10: mult_pad = 0, hence D <= 0.

l*per_2 = z(ad+bc) has exactly five essential variables (five derivatives with pairwise disjoint supports), so every pullback lies in Sub_5: mult_pad = 0 at a seven-row weight, i_pad = a, padded gap -5.
exclusions.note: Promoted from a documented assumption. Consequence: the unpadded +1 example at (19,7,2^5) supplies NO padded test at that weight.
